item.title: Actual Friends And "Kaam Ke Dost"
item.description: I LOVE HAVING FRIENDS. yes i am a somewhat lonely ass omnivert but i still love hanging out with them. I like can not live without them. “but shiva you are lowkey an introvert you should be fine being alone”. Yes, i like my me times. Sit back, listen to songs, read manga, drink some joos, meditate, study. Fr thats all i think i really like doing alone. The funny thing is i like doing the above mentioned things with friends too!

item.title: Opinion Wars And How To Deal With Them
item.description:
Has this ever happened to you before? Does not matter if you ever the person on the left or right. You cant say no.

SO what is going on here? We humans have a very deep and complex brain, and to add to it each person has a unique brain. Meaning that we all think and feel differently. This will naturally lead to conflict as we believe/accept what others are thinking as what I think is supreme and what they think is obviously wrong, right?

item.title: My Results On Various Personality Tests(old and outdated)
item.description:
I might redo this page with my recent results soon

the big 5 types

now this is an old quiz, and the website i gave it on also does not work anymore so thats a bummer anyways We were asked to do a quiz based on the ‘big five personality traits’. These are actually 10 types, but each person gets 1 out of pairs of two. The first is how open we are. We can either be closed or open minded. Then we have conscientiousness, where we can either be organized or disorganized. Next we have how social we are with introversion or extroversion. Next is how agreeable we are, like if we can understand other people and agree to them, the pairs here are agreeable and disagreeable. Lastly we have neuroticism, how negative emotionally we are, here we can either be calm or nervous.

item.title: The Seven Deadly Sins And Me(old)
item.description:
WEEBS STOP RIGHT THERE I AM NOT TALKING ABOUT THE ANIME

Now, the seven deadly sins has always been an interesting concept to me. I admire it like I admire the 9 layer’s of hell shown in Dante’s Inferno. They are a negative things but are oddly interesting.

We all have at least one of these in us. If you say no you are an ignorant fuck. Actually we have all of these in us, just the amount varies. Cope. These seven sins are pride, envy, sloth, lust, wrath, greed, gluttony.

item.title: Single, But Not Sorry(old and outdated)
item.description:
Love is all everyone wants to talk about. Conversation dying? just throw in a “hows your love life”, nothing to tease your friend about? pull this up. Honestly for me, saying my love life has been dull would be wrong because I never had one XD

So back to my pre fifth grade self. I was perfectly fine with girls my age. I was quite extroverted, and didn’t mind hanging out with girls. A big plus for me was that I have a twin sister, now she had a ton of female friends and if I was around my sister I had to be around them so I somehow got the hang of how to be with girls. I didn’t have a crush before 7th class(I was like a super super close friend of this girl in 5th but I don’t think we liked each other outside of that).

item.title: Everyone Should Be Empathetic
item.description: Empathy, the ability to put oneself in another person’s shoes. Sound’s easy right? It is easy for me as I was an INFP(now ENTP) but more so cuz i have gone through all lows and highs of life I can think of. However most people don’t. An important aspect required for being empathetic is the ability to put others before yourself. Now I know “what? why should i do that”. This is because when you remove the ‘I’ from the equation all there is left is the other person. Then try to see things from their perspective. This does requires a good understanding about the other person tho, like their nature, what mental state they are in and how they are with you e.t.c.

item.title: Listen, Listening Is Important
item.description: Ever felt like when you are talking to some and you feel man this guy just wont listen to me. Probably in some other conversation the guy must be like damn this mf wont stop. This is because a conversation has two parts. First is obviously speaking, the second is listening. Believe it or not the second is more important. Think of this like a game of catch. You throw a ball, the other guy catches it. Catching the ball is very important because if you keep throwing the ball and no one catches it, you are going nowhere.
